title: Hardcore wither heart totem of undying
description: This resource pack changes the texture of te totem of undying to a heart one.
body:
# Hardcore wither Heart Totem of Undying
Give your Totem of Undying a dark and dangerous makeover! This resource pack replaces the default totem with a Wither-style HUD heart, inspired by the withering health icon from the Minecraft hardcore vanilla interface.

### Why download it?

- Unique & Intimidating Look: The Wither heart instantly gives your totem a powerful, corrupted aesthetic.
- Perfect for Hardcore & Dark-Themed Worlds: Adds an edgy survival vibe without breaking the vanilla feel.
- Clean & Vanilla-Compatible: Fits naturally into the game’s original art style while still standing out.
- Lightweight & Compatible: Works smoothly with all other resource packs and shaders.

Survive with a heart touched by darkness!

## Terms of Use

You are free to use this resource pack in Minecraft, your videos, and your modpacks.

If you include it in a modpack or showcase it in a video, I would appreciate it if you add a link to this page in the description.

_**Do not redistribute or claim the pack as your own.**_
